unit.why: An anecdote, passed on through a chain of named witnesses, about the frail Maggid of Kozhenitz: carried to the study hall, he burns with fervour and seems to fly to the prayer stand.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises of the Maggid; (י) is self-contained and the next item (יא) begins a new report.

stories.start_quote: והי׳ מושכב במטה מחמת שהי' חולה
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozhenitz was so sick and emaciated that doctors wondered how he lived, yet when carried to the beit midrash he cried 'how awesome is this place', seemed to fly to the prayer stand, and prayed with burning fervour while standing on a soft bearskin.
